summary: [standards] evidence_add_130 asserts two of its Then clauses weakly. The tree snapshot is compared at :302, before the indexed run at :304-306, so 'the tree is unchanged after both' is not checked for the second run. 'Prints the bytes to sign' is only !stdout.is_empty() (:306), with no canon-approval-v1 or equality with the evidence.add.121 bytes. message.contains("root") (:300) also passes on the fixed words 'spec root' in the message (evidence.rs:803), so it cannot tell whether the project id is named. I signed: approval-payload is read-only and evidence_add_121 checks the tree after a successful payload on the same path. Fix: take the snapshot after the indexed run too, and assert the payload starts with the canon-approval-v1 document.
